subject: GlacierBank RFP - Support & field engagement questionnaire
messages:
From: Elena Mendoza <elena.mendoza@glacierbank.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@glacierbank.com, tom.rivera@glacierbank.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: GlacierBank RFP - clarifications on support coverage and escalation paths

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the RFP submission. As we review vendor responses, the procurement and platform teams at GlacierBank have a handful of clarifying questions specific to field engagement and operational handoffs. We would appreciate concise answers to the items below so we can circulate to our internal security and SRE reviewers: 

1) Primary TAM coverage model: please confirm hours (local PST) of TAM availability, guaranteed response times for critical/sev1 incidents, and whether you provide an on-call rotation that includes a named primary and secondary.

2) Escalation matrix: we need a single-page matrix showing who gets notified at each severity (customer TAM, support L2, engineering on-call, exec escalation) and expected notification cadence.

3) Weekend/holiday support: is there 24/7 coverage? If not, what are the options (paid retainer, on-call add-on)?

4) Incident notification templating: sample email/SMS templates you use for outage notifications and post-incident summaries.

5) Auditability: can you provide evidence of retained incident logs, notification timestamps, and tamper-resistant audit trails for 12 months? Also specify export formats.

6) Contactability: an operational phone number for emergencies and procedures for break-glass access requests.

If you can return a short one-page response per item plus the requested sample artifacts (matrix, templates), we can move to the legal/ops review this week.

Best,
Elena Mendoza
Director, Platform Procurement
GlacierBank

Attachments referenced: none

From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GlacierBank RFP - clarifications on support coverage and escalation paths

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. I'm looping in Marissa (Head of CS) and Karthik (TAM ops) to provide the details and artifacts. Initial notes below; we'll attach a completed questionnaire and the escalation matrix by EOD tomorrow.

Quick answers at a glance:
- TAM hours: 9am–6pm PT primary coverage (Mon–Fri) with 24/7 on-call engineering support for Sev1 under our standard enterprise package.
- Response targets: 15 minutes phone ack for Sev1, 1 hour engineering engagement; Sev2: 1 hour email ack; Sev3: 4 business hours.
- Weekend support: available via optional retainer or included at enterprise tier; we'll list pricing in the attachment.
- Audit logs/retention: 12-month retention available (exportable as JSON/CSV), with HMAC-backed delivery for integrity verification.

We'll include a sample notification template and a one-page escalation matrix in the package. If you'd like a short recorded walkthrough of the escalation flow, we can schedule 30 min.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: support_engagement_questionnaire_v1.xlsx (attached by internal team at next message)

Summary answers (condensed):
- TAM coverage: Primary TAM hours 09:00–18:00 PT Mon–Fri. 24/7 engineering on-call for Sev1 incidents. Named primary TAM + secondary backup provided at contract signature.
- Response SLA (enterprise): Sev1: 15 min phone ack, 1 hour engineering engagement; Sev2: 1 hour ack; Sev3: 4 business hours. Retainer options available for guaranteed weekend engineering.
- Escalation matrix: see escalation_matrix_glacier_v1.pdf — includes notional notification cadence and which contacts are notified at each threshold (TAM -> Support L2 -> Engineering on-call -> CS exec).
- Notification templates: provided two templates (outage initial + post-incident summary) as plain-text in the PDF.
- Auditability: incident timelines and notification stamps retained 12 months; exports available as JSON/CSV with per-entry HMAC signatures. Longer retention available by request.
- Emergency contact: Redwood escalation bridge +1-877-555-0199 (break-glass). For legal/forensic requests, evidence exports delivered via SFTP or signed Drive link.

Requested attachments: support_engagement_questionnaire_v1.xlsx; escalation_matrix_glacier_v1.pdf; tam_roster_template.csv
